name: wait_for_selected_object_turn

stack.evidence: func_001D13D8 does not access Script stackTop and returns pending state 4 while Script flag bit 1 is set

notes: Selected-object turn commands set Script flag bit 1 while their type-4 object operation is active; the completion path clears that bit. func_001D13D8 returns state 4 while the bit remains set and state 2 after it clears. In the JP corpus, the preceding command call is command 99 turn_selected_object_toward_position for 90 calls and command 69 turn_selected_object_to_angle for 63 calls; another 90 calls are repeated after wait_ticks in polling loops.
